elements_selected.content: Extend the zetl stats command output to include vault content integrity data per CON-006 extended. Add to stats JSON output: vault_content_hash (hex string of vault Merkle root from index.json), spl_blocks (count of all SPL blocks across vault), grounded_spl_blocks (count of SPL blocks with section grounding recorded in theory cache), explicitly_grounded_facts (count of SPL facts/rules with explicit source metadata). Read vault_root_hash from the loaded index cache. The count fields require the index to be loaded. If index not present, vault_content_hash is null. Add the same fields to table output. Per CON-006 extension in §7.
